chunks: “The first one to place the khutbah before the salat on the Day of Jumuʿah was ʿUthman, because when he prayed, the people would not remain for his sermon; rather, they would disperse and say: ‘What should we do with his admonitions when he himself does not take admonition by them, and he has introduced what he has introduced?’ So when he saw that, he placed the two sermons before the prayer.”

key_terms.أَحْدَثَ: introduced an innovation or new matter
key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, the time of congregational Jumuʿah worship
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer, here referring to the Jumuʿah prayer
key_terms.ٱلْخُطْبَةَ: the sermon delivered to the congregation

ai.seo_question: Who was the first to place the Jumuʿah khutbah before the prayer, and why?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that ʿUthman was the first to move the Jumuʿah sermons before the salat. The report presents this change as a response to people refusing to stay for his admonition due to his own conduct and innovations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1264 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

"The first to deliver the sermon (khutbah) before the prayer on Jumu’ah was Uthman because, when he would lead the prayer, the people would disperse after the prayer and not stay for his sermon, saying:
'What use is his preaching when he does not adhere to it himself, and he has introduced innovations?' When he noticed this, he placed the two sermons before the prayer."
